description: OmniCorp's only.357 handgun, this gas operated pistol with a classic wood finish in its furniture is not a mechanical copy of the Desert Eagle, for it is compatible with.357 magnum,.357 SIG and even.38 rounds thanks to its cleverly engineered magazines and action.  Such flexibility comes with a cost in bulk and limited magazine capacity.
//: Numbers for weight, volume, and length calculations are based upon weapon without caliber conversion. The difference will be made up for with integrated stats from the installable caliber conversion.

variants.description: Needing little introduction, the Desert Eagle's impact on popular culture is almost as massive as the pistol itself.  The newest Mark XIX model introduced a more modern optics rail.  It was sold in multiple hard-hitting magnum calibers and can swap between them using conversion kits and the appropriate magazine.

description: The action of OmniCorp's American Eagle.357 in a longer barrel, this gas operated hunting rifle features manageable recoil, a spacious magazine well within its tall grip, the elegant anachronism of wood furniture and a wide array of rounds it is compatible with thanks to cleverly engineered magazines and operation.  It is not a "bear gun" as in elephant gun.
